sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Sally BBQ Joint is a timing-based game that requires precision and attention to detail. As you cook steaks, you need to pay close attention to their temperature, as they can quickly go from perfectly cooked to burnt and inedible. The game is all about timing, as you need to flip the steaks at the right moment to prevent them from burning. This requires a combination of luck and skill, as you need to anticipate when the steaks will be ready to flip.

The game also features a variety of ingredients and seasonings that you can use to enhance the flavor of your steaks. These ingredients can be bought using coins that you earn by serving steaks to the lumberjacks. You can use these ingredients to create unique flavor combinations that will impress even the most discerning lumberjack.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new ingredients and seasonings, which will allow you to create even more complex and delicious flavor combinations. You'll also unlock new cooking techniques, such as grilling and sautéing, which will give you even more flexibility in the kitchen.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Sally BBQ Joint are simple yet challenging, making it a game that's easy to pick up but hard to master.
